index.title: The FDOrganizer
index.preIngestText: The tool can be used for data curation and organization before the data is transferred to a long-term archive
index.sourcesText: A variety of data sources, such as databases or electronic lab notebooks, can be connected to the FDOrganizer
index.archiveText: The data is automatically transferred to the connected long-term archive without any additional effort
index.import: Import research data from different source systems
index.importText: Research data can be imported easily from various connected data sources, such as electronic lab notebooks or databases
index.organizeText: The data can be organized and arranged in appropriate structures
index.metadataText: Metadata can be added and structured at different levels
index.edit1: Create data package and import the data from different sources
index.archive1: Agreement to the terms of use and definition of further requirements
index.reviewText: Review of the submitted data package by responsible parties

packageContentDocument.deleteText:
If the file was uploaded manually, it will be deleted.

With external files only the reference will be lost.
packageContentDocument.deleteQuestion: Do you really want to delete the file?

packageContentFolder.deleteText:
The folder, its metadata and all contained files and metadata will be deleted.

With contained external files only the reference and metadata will be lost.
packageContentFolder.deleteQuestion: Do you really want to delete the folder?

packageListItem.deleteText:
The files you have uploaded manually will be deleted.

References to external files will be lost.
packageListItem.deleteQuestion: Do you really want to delete the project?

metadataImport.title: Datacite JSON Data
metadataImport.explanation: This importer allows you to copy some information from already prepared datacite documents. The data model of FDO has some overlap with Datacite, but there are many incompatibilities. Please carefully check the newly added entries.

archiveSettings.introduction: Please consider the following legal requirements for archival and check the applicable boxes below.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.agreement: I have read and understood the Data Submission Agreement and request the processing of the submitted data in accordance with the options chosen above.
terms.duration: I attest that the cost for the preservation is covered for a minimum preservation period of {duration} years, starting with the successful archival of this package. I am aware that after the expiration of that time decisions about the further preservation of this package will be made by the institution named in the Data Submission Agreement

privacy.statement: I attest that all personal data in this package was processed in accordance following the EU General Data Protection Regulation. For this purpose I have taken the following measures:
privacy.removed: All existing personal data in this package was removed
privacy.anonymised: All existing personal data in this package was anonymised using standard procedures
privacy.consent: All existing personal data in this package was labeled accordingly. The remaining personal data is integral for its research purpose (as stated in Article 89 of the EU General Data Protection Regulation). Written consent to processing and archival of the data was obtained. The physical or digital storage location of the consent documents is linked in the metadata of the respective files
